data.body:
Final rebar-debug repair report (code ready; Gerrit landing pending):

Problem — scheduled reconcile-bridge runs fail before config/network and keep the `rebar-bridge-run-failures` CloudWatch alarm in ALARM.

Proven root cause — `src/rebar/_engine/rebar_reconciler/runtime.py` imported optional `pydantic.SecretStr` at module scope. Commit 40b8ac8295 made that runtime eager on every bridge pass, but the bridge installs core `.` without `[agents]`; `pyproject.toml:61-66` and `docs/config.md:44-52` require the engine/reconciler to remain stdlib-only.

Proof — clean no-extras installs reproduce `ModuleNotFoundError` at runtime.py:39; installing only Pydantic clears it. Historical dynamic A/B succeeds at 0f7461d243 and 557f8c16e35, then fails at 40b8ac8295 when the runtime becomes eager. AWS account 896586841071/us-east-1 independently shows `rebar-bridge-run-failures` entered ALARM at 2026-08-18 04:39:28 PDT after 2/2 hourly failures and remained at metric value 1.

Test — `tests/unit/test_core_optionality.py::test_lean_workflow_runtime_pulls_no_heavy_stack` loads the real packaged reconciler runtime in a subprocess whose import hook rejects Pydantic. Its final form also asserts the credential is absent from repr/equality/hash while exact reveal remains available. With the full original Pydantic implementation restored it is RED with `ModuleNotFoundError: pydantic blocked by clean-runtime oracle`; after repair it is GREEN. Reintroducing the exact module-scope dependency returns it to RED. Collected/executed under pytest and the gating `make lint` suite.

Fix — `StaticAuth.secret` is now a frozen stdlib string field with `repr=False, compare=False`; `reveal()` returns it only at the existing Cloud/DC authentication boundaries. No new capability or dependency was added.

Scope and safety — callers still receive the same exact token at `runtime.py:148` and `:202`; the only observable change is removal of the undeclared import prerequisite. Existing tests were strengthened, not weakened. Final gates: 23 relevant tests pass; `make lint` passes; `make typecheck` passes; `git diff --check` passes. A fresh Python 3.12 `pip install .` contains no Pydantic yet imports `rebar_reconciler.runtime`; repr stays masked and exact reveal succeeds.

Siblings — construct sweep of `src/rebar/_engine` found no other module-scope optional imports. The two Jira-package imports are lazy at adapter call boundaries (`transport.py:141`, `retry.py:93`) and are not siblings. Parity invariant: every automated bridge channel must run from the core install without agents extras. GitHub (`.github/workflows/reconcile-bridge.yml:289`), Jenkins (`Jenkinsfile:96`), and GitLab (`.gitlab-ci.yml:62`) all call the shared `rebar bridge run`; library orchestration shares the same runtime. No MISSING channel was found; MCP/dual-direction are N/A to the scheduled bridge runner.

Residual risk and prevention — the separate REB-3162 visibility failure remains dispositioned to `dutiable-shaded-honeyeater` and awaits authorization for a live Jira mutation. No other optional-import sibling was observed.

Replication — the original package shape (Python 3.12, `pip install .`, no Pydantic) now imports the real reconciler runtime successfully. A post-merge scheduled bridge run is still required to clear the operational alarm before this ticket closes.
